n76166e31e5.headline: Urgent.. The dollar falls by two piasters in all banks
n76166e31e5.summary: The exchange rate of the US dollar against the Egyptian pound declined by two piasters across all banks, according to the latest bank website updates.
n76166e31e5.why: Currency fluctuations affect import costs, inflation, and foreign investment flows in Egypt’s economy.

impacts.name: Egyptian pound
impacts.why: Dollar weakening against the pound indicates currency appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n76166e31e5.why_moved: The dollar’s decline against the Egyptian pound reflects currency market adjustments impacting trade and capital flows.
